attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Push the defender Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Hulk Smash!
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Throw the defender |!range_small|.
|!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Gamma Leap
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current location. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Strongest One There Is
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 2 and throw it |!range_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Hulk Not Puny Banner
superPowers.body: While this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack it may use this superpower. This character may reroll any number of its defense dice, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Inner Rage
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 2 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: You Won‘t Like Me When I‘m Angry
superPowers.body: Add one die to this character’s attack rolls for every 4 |!damage| it has. Additionally, if this character would flip its Stat Card to the Injured side, it is KO’d instead.

erratas.body: Hulk Smash doesn't require a trigger for the Throw special rule anymore, previously it required a |!wild|.
Gamma Leap's Power Cost increased from 3 to 4.
Strongest One There Is now throws an interactive terrain feature |!range_large|, instead of an either an enemy character or an interactive terrain feature |!range_medium|.
Strike's Strength increased from 6 to 7. It now generates |!power| based on |!damage| dealt (builder).
Hulk Not Puny Banner |!reactive| superpower added.
You Won't Like Me When I'm Angry now grants 1 additional attack die for every 4 |!damage|, instead of every 3 |!damage|.
Hulk is now immune to Stun.
